svg.aria-label: Experiment 1. Share of turns on which each tutor did the step the teacher's policy requires, on 60 test conversations and three reply models. A carefully written prompt with a guardrail: 57 to 73 turns in 100. The Harness with the policy decided by code: 83 to 89 in 100. The prompt alone: 44 to 68. The Harness with the policy in words: 46 to 56.
svg.text: Experiment 1: turns on which the tutor did the step the teacher’s policy requires
60 test conversations of six learner turns for each tutor and reply model. 324 turns require a step.
A judge that isn’t told which tutor wrote a reply says what the reply did.
More help than the policy allows
Harness, policy in code, read by rules
The plain tutor and the Harness read by rules were run on one reply model. The policy: a question before any try, a hint after one, a worked example after two, never the answer.
